# Optional QMD sidecar for local hybrid markdown search (BM25 + GGUF embeddings + reranker).
# Enabled via: podman-compose --profile qmd up -d
FROM docker.io/library/node:22-slim

RUN apt-get update \
    && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends python3 build-essential git ca-certificates \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

RUN npm install -g @tobilu/qmd

USER node
ENV HOME=/home/node

EXPOSE 8181

ENTRYPOINT ["qmd", "mcp", "--http", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8181"]
